description: This file defines the SugarFolder class, which manages folder operations such as creation, deletion, subscription management, and retrieval within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM system. It includes methods for handling email folders, dynamic queries, and folder hierarchy.

classes.name: SugarFolder
classes.description: A class for managing email and system folders, including CRUD operations, subscriptions, hierarchy, and retrieval functions within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing folder management with optional user, language, and configuration parameters.

methods.name: deleteEmailFromAllFolder
methods.description: Deletes an email from all folders.

methods.name: deleteEmailFromFolder
methods.description: Deletes an email from a specific folder.

methods.name: checkEmailExistForFolder
methods.description: Checks if an email exists in the folder.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves a bean (email) from one folder to another.

methods.name: copyBean
methods.description: Copies a bean (email) from one folder to another.

methods.name: setFolder
methods.description: Creates a new group folder with specified fields.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves folder subscriptions for a user.

methods.name: setSubscriptions
methods.description: Sets user folder subscriptions, including parent folders.

methods.name: insertFolderSubscription
methods.description: Inserts a folder subscription record for a user.

methods.name: getParentIDRecursive
methods.description: Recursively retrieves parent folder IDs up to root.

methods.name: clearSubscriptions
methods.description: Clears all folder subscriptions for a user.

methods.name: clearSubscriptionsForFolder
methods.description: Clears all subscriptions for a specific folder.

methods.name: generateArchiveFolderQuery
methods.description: Generates SQL query for archived emails.

methods.name: generateSugarsDynamicFolderQuery
methods.description: Generates dynamic folder SQL query based on folder type.

methods.name: getListItemsForEmailXML
methods.description: Retrieves email list items for display in XML format.

methods.name: getDynamicFolderCount
methods.description: Counts items in a dynamic folder, optionally only unread.

methods.name: getCountItems
methods.description: Counts total items in a folder.

methods.name: getCountUnread
methods.description: Counts unread items in a folder.

methods.name: addBean
methods.description: Associates a SugarBean (email, etc.) with the folder.

methods.name: retrieveFoldersForProcessing
methods.description: Retrieves folders for processing, optionally only subscribed.

methods.name: getGroupFoldersForSettings
methods.description: Prepares group folders for user settings interface.

methods.name: getFoldersForSettings
methods.description: Prepares folders for user settings, including nested folders.

methods.name: removeDeletedFolders
methods.description: Removes folders marked as deleted or invalid.

methods.name: getFoldersChildForSettings
methods.description: Recursively retrieves child folders for settings.

methods.name: getCountNewItems
methods.description: Counts new/unread items in a folder.

methods.name: getUserFolders
methods.description: Builds folder tree structure for user interface.

methods.name: buildTreeNodeRefresh
methods.description: Builds folder node data for UI refresh.

methods.name: buildTreeNodeFolders
methods.description: Builds folder tree nodes for display.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Flags a folder as deleted, cascading to children.

methods.name: deleteChildrenCascade
methods.description: Recursively deletes child folders.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves folder data to database, creating or updating.

methods.name: addSubscriptionsToGroupFolder
methods.description: Adds default subscriptions to a group folder.

methods.name: createSubscriptionForUser
methods.description: Creates a subscription record for a user.

methods.name: updateFolder
methods.description: Updates folder properties and hierarchy.

methods.name: findAllChildren
methods.description: Finds all child folder IDs recursively.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves folder data by ID.

methods.name: getFirstDisplayFolders
methods.description: Returns the first folder to display for user.

methods.name: isToDisplay
methods.description: Checks if a folder should be displayed based on subscriptions.

methods.name: shouldFolderDisplay
methods.description: Helper to determine if folder is in display list.

methods.name: getUserAccessibleInboundIds
methods.description: Retrieves inbound email account IDs accessible to user.
